# Rule 6 - Respect consent, and accessibility statements:
\n
The staff of Aurora's Song is made up of English speakers primarily, as is much of the community. For the ease of moderation and communication should be in English within the discord server and game.
This doesn't mean you or your characters can't use regional terms/phrases from other languages. If it is suspected you are doing so to hide slurs, or other rule breaks, you will be banned in accordance with their respective rules.
